answer: Each bonded identity is tied to an escrow, so splitting stake across k Sybil identities does not erase shared evidence. If they equivocate on the same thread, the protocol detects correlated pairs and assesses penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). When enforcement recurs across rounds, confiscation and asymmetric depreciation can compound, giving a detected swarm an exponential capital-loss multiplier; the vault preserves evidence, not a relic of anonymity.
